title: Eden (Garden of Eden)
summary: The garden God planted "eastward in Eden" where Adam and Eve lived before the Fall. Location unknown; the Flood remade the earth's geography.
coordinate_basis: No coordinates: OpenBible.info's top identification is "unknown location" (55% confidence). Alternatives listed there: Armenia 20%, Babylonia 15%, near Ur <10%, Canaan <10%, Egypt <10%.

certainty.basis: OpenBible.info: unknown location, 55% confidence (percent refers to the "unknown" identification). Rivers named in Gen 2:10–14 do not fix a post-Flood location.
